DeepStream Customize App

For particular detection & saving in local file.

Download

Grab the custom source bundle and copy it to the target Jetson:

deepstream-app-custom.zip
Click to download

Setup on a New Jetson

Step 1Copy the folder

Extract deepstream-app-custom.zip and copy the folder to the new Jetson (via scp, rsync, or USB).

Step 2Build

From inside the custom app folder on the Jetson, run:

$export CUDA_VER=12.6
$make clean
$make
Step 3Run the custom app

Launch the locally built binary using the existing DeepStream-Yolo config:

$./deepstream-app -c ~/DeepStream-Yolo/deepstream_app_config.txt

Fallback — Run the Original DeepStream

If you need the unmodified, system-installed DeepStream binary instead of the custom build, use:

$deepstream-app -c ~/DeepStream-Yolo/deepstream_app_config.txt

Note — no leading ./ here. This calls the binary on the system PATH from the standard DeepStream install.
